creative_direction.audience: a Tokyo concept-store buyer and a senior lifestyle merchandiser
creative_direction.desired_response: a quiet, natural frame that earns attention through proportion, air and believable light
creative_direction.art_direction: an incidental-looking Instagram cafe photograph with precisely controlled scale and negative space
creative_direction.restraint: one product, one table, one wall and one light idea

reference_binding.runtime_role: camera, composition, light, support surface and optional declared container design
reference_binding.provider_submission: allowed only as an explicitly declared reference input with copy exclusions

camera_geometry.distortion: no close-phone looming or edge stretch
camera_geometry.depth_of_field: product sharp with gentle physically caused plane falloff, never portrait masking

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: single-product slot envelope; adapt width to product aspect ratio without exceeding 0.18
composition_geometry.negative_space: at least 68 percent meaningful warm-neutral white wall and table
composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: small lower-field focal point beneath a large quiet wall field
composition_geometry.crop_policy: retain the complete product, its soft shadow and breathing space

composition_variation.selection: choose a deterministic small x-offset and tonal falloff from the request seed
composition_variation.repeat_guard: adjacent outputs may not share both the same product x-position and the same wall-light falloff

lighting_geometry.source_topology: one very large diffused left window plus weak neutral room bounce
lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: broad protected white and glass highlights with no clipped patch
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: transparent containers retain rim thickness, refraction and a faint physically connected transmitted lift

tone_signature.white_point: warm-neutral textured white, never broad pure white
tone_signature.contrast_curve: gentle toe, quiet midtone separation and soft highlight shoulder
tone_signature.saturation: low globally while preserving product-local fruit or beverage color
tone_signature.shadow_color: quiet neutral to faintly cool gray
tone_signature.material_separation: glass, liquid, wall and table remain distinct without local-contrast exaggeration
tone_signature.local_contrast: moderate only at product rim, liquid boundary and support contact

finish_signature.acuity: finite social-photo acuity with identity details readable and no uniform tack sharpness
finish_signature.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression
finish_signature.depth_rendering: geometry and light falloff before softness
finish_signature.retouching: materially honest, retaining slight wall, table and drink irregularity
